item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-1f69bfc466f0119c","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"In September 2023, the president announced increasing the government-sector minimum wage to 4,000 Egyptian pounds for the lowest grade, alongside raising the exceptional cost-of-living allowance from 300 to 600 pounds and the annual tax-exemption threshold to 45,000 pounds; the increase was to take effect in October after parliamentary approval.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.9","6B.1","6B.2","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"2023; announced during the target period, with implementation scheduled for October 2023","ruler_attribution":"The measures were announced by the President and described by the Finance Minister.","limitations":["The source is an advocacy organization’s analysis and does not independently verify execution or fiscal effects."]},{"source_id":"SRC-1f69bfc466f0119c","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"The September 2023 wage increase covered government workers but excluded private-sector and informal workers; the private-sector minimum wage had risen from 2,700 to 3,000 pounds beginning in July, without a binding enforcement mechanism, leaving millions without comparable protection.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.9","6B.2","6B.3","6B.7","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the government-sector decision to the President and describes the National Wages Council’s private-sector decision.","limitations":["The source does not provide an official implementation audit."]},{"source_id":"SRC-1f69bfc466f0119c","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"EIPR reported that private-sector workers lost 33% of the real value of wages over the preceding ten years, while public-sector workers’ wages increased by about 9%; it also reported inflation rising approximately 60.5% from October 2020 to August 2023.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.9","5B.10","6B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The quantitative comparison covers roughly 2013–2023; inflation measure covers October 2020–August 2023","ruler_attribution":"The findings assess wage policy during el-Sisi’s rule but do not attribute each change solely to him.","limitations":["These are figures reported by EIPR; the supplied text does not provide the underlying dataset."]},{"source_id":"SRC-1f69bfc466f0119c","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"EIPR reported that Egypt lacked a universal minimum wage covering public, private, and informal workers; lacked binding annual review and enforcement mechanisms, a complaints mechanism, and protection against reprisals for workers seeking compliance.","question_ids":["5B.4","5B.5","5B.7","5B.8","6B.2","6B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Status reported in September 2023","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns the national legal and administrative framework under the government.","limitations":["The source is an independent civil-society assessment rather than an official legal review."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ef5abb1ac1c18aa0","start_unit":6,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"In November 2023, Egyptian and international human-rights organizations submitted a report to the UN Committee Against Torture alleging that torture, enforced disappearance, ill-treatment, and medical neglect in detention were systematic; the report alleged state agencies, courts, and prosecutors protected perpetrators from accountability and that arbitrary detention and torture continued against opponents before the presidential election.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.5","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","4B.9","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Report submitted November 2023; allegations describe patterns over the preceding decade and continuing into 2023","ruler_attribution":"The organizations attribute the alleged pattern to Egyptian authorities and state institutions during el-Sisi’s presidency.","limitations":["This records allegations and the report’s evidentiary basis, not a final judicial finding."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ced635d416443e0a","start_unit":13,"end_unit":14,"fact_summary":"On 18 July 2023, an Egyptian emergency state security court sentenced academic and human-rights researcher Patrick George Zaki to three years for allegedly spreading false news based on a 2019 article about discrimination against Coptic Christians; the organizations reported that the trial involved due-process violations.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.3","3B.5","3B.7","3B.8","4B.3","4B.4","4B.9","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Sentencing occurred during 2023; arrest and detention began in 2020","ruler_attribution":"The case was adjudicated by an Egyptian emergency state security court under the state security framework overseen by the executive.","limitations":["The source is a joint civil-society condemnation and does not reproduce the full court record."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ced635d416443e0a","start_unit":14,"end_unit":14,"fact_summary":"The organizations reported that Zaki was arrested at Cairo Airport in February 2020, held incommunicado for 24 hours, beaten, stripped, electrocuted, verbally abused, and threatened; after 22 months in detention he was released pending trial in December 2021 under a travel ban and was returned to custody after the July 2023 verdict.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.5","3B.8","4B.3","6B.8","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Conduct began in 2020 and continued through the 2023 sentencing period","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the conduct to Egyptian authorities.","limitations":["The allegations are reported by the signatory organizations and are not independently adjudicated in the supplied text."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ced635d416443e0a","start_unit":14,"end_unit":15,"fact_summary":"The organizations stated that emergency-court verdicts were not appealable and required presidential ratification, while the President could commute or quash the sentence; they further stated that taking Zaki back into custody pending ratification violated Circular No. 10 of 2017.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.5","4B.4","7B.7","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Legal framework and alleged violation applied to the July 2023 verdict","ruler_attribution":"The source identifies presidential ratification and clemency authority under the emergency-court system.","limitations":["The legal interpretation and alleged violation are presented by the organizations, not resolved by a cited court decision."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a66fd611d016c5e7","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"At el-Sisi’s invitation, Egypt convened the Cairo Peace Summit on 21 October 2023 with regional and international leaders and envoys to discuss containing the Gaza crisis and military de-escalation; the presidency stated that the summit sought consensus on civilian protection, international humanitarian law, humanitarian access, and preventing regional spillover.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.7","2B.10","3B.9","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"21 October 2023","ruler_attribution":"The Presidency states that el-Sisi invited the participants and that Egypt called the summit.","limitations":["The communiqué records stated aims and diplomatic activity, not whether the summit achieved de-escalation or aid outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a66fd611d016c5e7","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The Egyptian presidency declared support for a two-state solution, an independent Palestinian state on the June 1967 borders with East Jerusalem as capital, continued work with partners despite conflict duration, and rejection of calls to liquidate the Palestinian cause.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.7","2B.10","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Position stated on 21 October 2023","ruler_attribution":"The position was issued by the Egyptian Presidency under el-Sisi.","limitations":["This is an official statement of policy position and does not establish implementation or causal results."]},{"source_id":"SRC-46b7c155543ac531","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"At el-Sisi’s invitation, Egypt convened the Sudan’s Neighboring States Summit in Cairo on 13 July 2023; participating states called for immediate and sustainable ceasefire, non-interference, preservation of Sudan’s institutions, humanitarian aid, safe passage, and an inclusive political dialogue.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.7","2B.10","3B.9","6B.6","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"13 July 2023","ruler_attribution":"The Presidency states that el-Sisi invited the participating heads of state and governments.","limitations":["The communiqué records collective commitments and does not demonstrate that the ceasefire or aid objectives were achieved."]},{"source_id":"SRC-46b7c155543ac531","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"The summit agreed to create a ministerial mechanism of Sudan’s neighboring states, with a first meeting in N’Djamena, tasked with developing an action plan through direct communication with Sudanese parties, coordinating with IGAD and the African Union, and establishing a humanitarian-delivery mechanism.","question_ids":["2B.7","2B.10","6B.6","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Agreement made 13 July 2023; subsequent implementation is not documented in the supplied text","ruler_attribution":"The mechanism was established through the summit Egypt convened under el-Sisi.","limitations":["No evidence is supplied regarding the mechanism’s later meetings, outputs, or effectiveness."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0c96939cd2b6799d","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"After the December 2023 presidential election result, el-Sisi said the election scene was free of transgressions and security violations despite the crowds, thanked the army, police, and judiciary for securing and supervising it, and described the election as producing diverse ideas from competing candidates.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.2","4B.3","4B.4","4B.6","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Statement delivered 18 December 2023 about the 2023 election","ruler_attribution":"The claims are el-Sisi’s own post-election account.","limitations":["The speech is self-reporting and does not independently verify election integrity or absence of violations."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0c96939cd2b6799d","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"In his post-election speech, el-Sisi pledged to continue the national dialogue, develop political and party life, and build a democratic state governed by law and the constitution; he also thanked competing candidates and called the electoral process diverse.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.3","4B.8","8B.1","8B.2","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Pledge made 18 December 2023","ruler_attribution":"Direct commitment by el-Sisi.","limitations":["The speech does not establish subsequent enactment, implementation, or institutional independence."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3ca3fe347fb08c28","start_unit":5,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"On 2 October 2023, el-Sisi said he directed the government and relevant authorities to study the national dialogue’s outcomes and pledged to continue the dialogue and develop political and party life through multiple paths and visions.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.6","8B.1","8B.2","8B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"2 October 2023","ruler_attribution":"Direct statement by el-Sisi.","limitations":["The supplied speech does not identify which recommendations were adopted or implemented."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3ca3fe347fb08c28","start_unit":5,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"El-Sisi announced on 2 October 2023 that he would seek another presidential term and invited Egyptians to participate in the election and choose among candidates, describing diversity and political differences as valuable.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.2","4B.3","4B.8","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Announcement made 2 October 2023 for the 2023 election","ruler_attribution":"Direct announcement by el-Sisi.","limitations":["The speech records the stated electoral program but does not independently assess contestability or equal treatment of candidates."]},{"source_id":"SRC-138b3f6eb44c869f","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"On Labor Day 2023, el-Sisi announced creating an emergency relief fund for irregular workers, transferring social and health dues into it, and providing 1,000 Egyptian pounds in emergency funding to irregular workers not covered by social-protection programs once legal procedures were completed.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.9","6B.1","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","6B.9","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Announcement made 1 May 2023","ruler_attribution":"Direct decision announced by el-Sisi.","limitations":["The speech states intended activation after legal procedures but supplies no disbursement data."]},{"source_id":"SRC-138b3f6eb44c869f","start_unit":5,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"El-Sisi directed public, public-business, and private-sector establishments to employ persons with disabilities at 5% of their workforce, ordered preparation of a national labor-market information platform, and called for procedures to increase women’s employment, provide safe workplaces, and integrate women into the labor market.","question_ids":["5B.4","5B.6","5B.8","6B.3","6B.8","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directives announced 1 May 2023","ruler_attribution":"Directives issued by el-Sisi in the Labor Day speech.","limitations":["The source does not establish enforcement, compliance rates, or outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-138b3f6eb44c869f","start_unit":5,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"El-Sisi directed the Supreme Council for Social Dialogue on employment to study the draft labor law with worker and employer representatives, promote compliance with ratified international labor conventions, and expand training programs and training centers under the Decent Life initiative.","question_ids":["5B.4","5B.7","6B.2","6B.4","6B.8","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directives announced 1 May 2023","ruler_attribution":"Directives issued by el-Sisi.","limitations":["No later legislative text, implementation record, or evaluation is supplied."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5fb6037e2bc6c16b","start_unit":5,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"World Bank WITS reported Egypt’s 2023 exports at US$42.553 billion and imports at US$84.218 billion, with 2,990 exported products and 4,048 imported products traded with 182 and 184 partners respectively.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.4","5B.10","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"National outcome during el-Sisi’s rule; the dataset does not attribute the figures to a specific presidential decision.","limitations":["Trade totals alone do not establish policy quality, causation, distribution, or welfare effects."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5fb6037e2bc6c16b","start_unit":14,"end_unit":17,"fact_summary":"In 2023, Egypt’s exports were concentrated mainly in consumer goods (39.87%) and intermediate goods (37.96%), while imports included intermediate goods (30.85%), consumer goods (30.04%), and capital goods (18.28%); country trade growth was reported at -9.03% and trade balance at -US$8.862 billion.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.4","5B.9","5B.10","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"2023","ruler_attribution":"National economic outcomes during el-Sisi’s rule; no specific
